consultation_structure.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Maintains organized, structured consultation
        - Manages consultation flow effectively
        - Shows clear progression through assessment
        - Maintains appropriate timing
        - Demonstrates natural, engaging approach

consultation_style.description:
Competent if ALL:
        - Demonstrates empathic and non-judgmental approach
        - Maintains appropriate therapeutic boundaries
        - Adapts communication to patient's mental state
        - Shows respect for patient's experiences and beliefs

generic_domains.description:
Communication skills feedback with specific examples.
        Strengths should highlight effective communication techniques.
        Improvements should focus on interview style and patient interaction.
        Example strength: "Excellent use of silence when discussing sensitive topics"
        Example improvement: "Need to avoid medical jargon when explaining diagnosis"

language_use.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Uses appropriate language for scenario
        - Avoids unnecessary medical jargon
        - Adapts language to patient's level
        - Uses non-stigmatizing terminology
        - Explains technical terms clearly

listening_skills.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Shows excellent listening skills
        - Responds appropriately to verbal/non-verbal cues
        - Demonstrates active listening consistently
        - Picks up on important patient signals
        - Uses appropriate silences

professional_behavior.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Shows appropriate professional attitude
        - Maintains appropriate boundaries
        - Displays appropriate behavior throughout
        - Demonstrates genuine empathy
        - Shows cultural sensitivity

questioning_technique.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Uses appropriate questioning style
        - Balances open and closed questions
        - Avoids leading questions
        - Clarifies information effectively
        - Adapts questioning approach appropriately

improvements.description: Specific examples of areas needing improvement, at least 3 examples
improvements.title: Improvements

strengths.description: Specific examples of effective performance, at least 2 examples
strengths.title: Strengths

suggested_actions.description: Concrete steps for improvement, must be clear and actionable, at least 3 steps
suggested_actions.title: Suggested Actions

competent.description:
Boolean indicating if competency was demonstrated. 
        True: Meets all expected standards with clear evidence
        False: Does not meet minimum competency requirements or shows significant deficiencies
competent.title: Competent

examination_competence.description:
Competent if ALL:
        - Conducts systematic mental state examination
        - Demonstrates appropriate use of cognitive testing
        - Shows sensitivity in examining difficult topics
        - Maintains professional boundaries during examination

formulates_diagnosis.description:
Competent if ALL:
        - Generates appropriate psychiatric differential diagnoses
        - Considers biopsychosocial factors in formulation
        - Uses diagnostic criteria correctly
        - Identifies comorbid conditions

generic_domains.description:
Mental state examination feedback with specific examples.
        Strengths should highlight effective examination techniques.
        Improvements should focus on examination thoroughness and approach.
        Example strength: "Systematic assessment of thought content and form"
        Example improvement: "Need to document objective findings more clearly"

identifies_findings.description:
Competent if ALL:
        - Accurately identifies abnormal mental state findings
        - Observes and documents appearance and behavior
        - Assesses cognitive function appropriately
        - Notes objective signs of mental illness

recognizes_implications.description:
Competent if ALL:
        - Recognizes significance of mental state findings
        - Links examination findings to diagnostic criteria
        - Identifies severity indicators
        - Recognizes signs requiring urgent intervention

CascHistoryModel.description: Assessment of psychiatric history taking skills with detailed competency criteria

assesses_risk.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Conducts thorough risk assessment
        - Explores all relevant risk factors
        - Establishes current risk level clearly
        - Addresses immediate safety concerns
        - Documents risk assessment comprehensively

explores_physical_health.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Pays appropriate attention to physical health
        - Considers physical health implications
        - Addresses physical health monitoring needs
        - Explores relevant medication effects
        - Investigates physical health concerns

explores_symptoms.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Elicits presence of key symptoms effectively
        - Explores symptoms in appropriate detail
        - Investigates relevant associated symptoms
        - Maintains comprehensive history taking
        - Gathers detailed symptom information systematically

generic_domains.description:
History taking feedback with specific examples.
        Strengths should highlight effective history gathering techniques.
        Improvements should focus on history structure and content.
        Example strength: "Excellent systematic exploration of depressive symptoms"
        Example improvement: "Need to explore impact of symptoms on daily functioning more thoroughly"

identifies_priorities.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Identifies and prioritizes key presenting issues clearly
        - Maintains structured and organized history taking
        - Recognizes and responds to urgent clinical concerns
        - Gathers critical information systematically
        - Shows genuine engagement rather than formulaic approach

identifies_psychosocial.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Gathers appropriate psychological information
        - Obtains relevant social information
        - Explores important psychosocial context
        - Assesses impact on daily functioning
        - Investigates support systems effectively

recognizes_significance.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Recognizes clinical significance of key symptoms
        - Makes appropriate connections between symptoms
        - Identifies patterns suggesting mental health conditions
        - Shows clear clinical reasoning in follow-up questions
        - Picks up on critical aspects of history

CascHistoryModel.title: CascHistoryModel

generic_domains.description:
Management planning feedback with specific examples.
        Strengths should highlight effective management decisions.
        Improvements should focus on treatment planning and risk management.
        Example strength: "Comprehensive risk management plan with clear contingencies"
        Example improvement: "Need to consider broader range of treatment options"

management_plan.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Develops comprehensive management plan
        - Reflects current best practice
        - Considers appropriate treatment options
        - Incorporates patient preferences
        - Plans appropriate follow-up

problem_formulation.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Formulates problems effectively
        - Synthesizes information clearly
        - Integrates findings appropriately
        - Identifies key clinical issues
        - Shows organized approach to formulation

psychosocial_interventions.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Identifies appropriate psychological interventions
        - Suggests relevant social interventions
        - Addresses support needs comprehensively
        - Includes important psychosocial aspects
        - Takes holistic approach to care

risk_management.description:
Competent if demonstrates ALL:
        - Develops comprehensive risk management plan
        - Addresses all identified risks
        - Creates appropriate safety plan
        - Includes effective crisis planning
        - Implements risk mitigation strategies

issue.description: Issue that needs to be addressed, give relevant examples from the transcript
issue.title: Issue

examples.description: Example of the strength, give relevant examples from the transcript
examples.title: Examples
